title: Actual Move-In Date
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM

You can change the date of a move-in after it has been created without affecting the move-out that precedes it. To do this, choose
Edit» Change Move-In Date

Actual Move-In Date
In addition to the move-in date, the actual move-in date can be entered as the date from which the premise is occupied.
Save

When you save the move-in, the initial move-in or move-in/out screen reappears. In Customizing under Define Control Parameters
at Document Level, you can configure the system so that when you save the data, a log is displayed containing information on the
changes made to the data.

Certain move-in activities, for example, maintaining a budget billing plan, are based on the database changes made by the move-in.
In these instances, you can, in Customizing under Move-In/Out -> Move-In -> Define Control Parameters at Document Level
configure the system to either output a confirmation prompt or save the data automatically before the action is carried out.

You can also save your changes in the move-in without leaving the move-in screen. To do this, choose Save and Hold.

Master Data (Move-In)

Use

During move-in processing, one or more contracts are created to commence on the specified move-in date. The installations you
specified at the start of processing are allocated to these contracts.

If the move-in date is in a period in which one of the installations has already been billed then the move-in cannot be created.

You can save changes to business partner and contract account data as scheduled changes. This means that the changes are not
activated until a future date. This date is determined by subtracting the interval period defined in Customizing from the move-in
date. For more information on how to define the interval period, see Customizing under |)*SAP Utilities Customer Service

Process Execution } Move-In/Move-Out » Define System Parameters for Move-in and Move-Out 3). Scheduled changes are
activated by report BUSPCDACT (activation of scheduled change documents for an application object).

When a move-in is created, the tax jurisdiction code of the connection object address is copied to all the contracts of the move-in
document, as well as to all the business partner addresses that were automatically created through the move-in.

Standard Business Partner Address

In Customizing (|}#SAP Utilities » Customer Service » Process Execution » Move-In/Out » Move-In » Define Move-In Control
Parameters at Document Level | ), you can configure the system so that the business partner receives the address of the premise
he/she is moving into as the default address. If you want to process the move-in for different premises in one move-in document,
the system uses the premise address of the installation that was entered first.

You can find additional information in the section on the master data component.

Using the Business Add-In (Badl) ISU_LMOVEIN_SETBPADDR, you can allocate a default value to the standard address.
